description: PRD-002: Looks PoC. One Look format (catalogue keys only), Ember as the default Look across every screen, a 'Make it yours' Looks editor, saved/exported/imported Looks, Auto following the Look, and a live style page computed from the active Look. Stacked on the PRD-001 pilot. Zero changes to automatos-ai.

userStories.title: The Look format and catalogue
userStories.description: As a designer, I want one precise format for a Look so Looks can be saved, shared and checked.
acceptanceCriteria: All criteria of L-001 in docs/prd/PRD-002-LOOKS-POC.md: catalogue.ts (4 grounds, 6 accents with ink, 4 type styles, 4 shells with filter, 4 lights, values exactly as in the Ember Looks prototype), the fixed error #FF6B6B, types.ts (Look v1), presets.ts (Ember default, Obsidian, Aurora, Workshop, Daylight), and validate.ts (pure, typed result, rejects unknown keys, values outside the catalogue, glow outside 0–40, wrong schema, name/sub over 40 chars)
lib/looks/contrast.ts with the WCAG luminance/contrast helpers and readableOn() as specified in L-002 of the PRD (built here because the L-001 tests need it)

Tests: every preset validates; each rejection case; contrast for all 24 ground x accent pairs (text and text2 on bg and surface, ink on accent, readableOn(accent) and readableOn(error) on bg and surface, all >= 4.5:1)
docs/SKILL-GAPS.md gains a 'Design gaps' entry: raw accent and error colours as text fail AA on Paper (molten 2.49:1, error 2.41:1), fixed by the derived text colours
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Built lib/looks/{catalogue,types,presets,validate,contrast}.ts + tests/looks/*. Next stories: use validateLook() for every Look from storage/import, isKeyOf() for catalogue lookups, readableOn(colour, bg, surface, text) for --accent-text/--error-text (molten on Paper = #AA4C1C, error = #A54B49; PRD's 'about #A84A1B/#A84A49').
